items.briefing:
Australian organisations should be aware that home battery systems — increasingly common following energy incentives — are now being flagged as a cybersecurity compliance concern. If your organisation or staff connect these devices to work networks or use them on business premises, they may introduce security risks that need to be assessed under your existing compliance obligations.

Separately, multiple updates across AI platforms this week reflect growing pressure to secure AI tools used in workplaces. If your organisation uses AI assistants or enterprise platforms, check that access controls and usage policies are up to date.

**Tip:** Ask your IT team whether any AI tools staff use at work have been reviewed for security settings recently.
